title: Square-root-logarithmic Wick variational rate from a Malliavin bump trial

free_cost.chain_rule: D b_N(X_N)=b_N'(X_N) D X_N and E||D X_N||^2=4
free_cost.frequency_bound: H0=dGamma(omega) and omega_max(N)=O(N), so q0[b_N(X_N)]<=4 ||b'||_infinity^2 omega_max(N)=O(N)
free_cost.dominance: N^(1+alpha+o(1))/(sigma_N R_N)=N^(alpha-3/2+o(1))/sqrt(log N) tends to zero for alpha<3/2

variational_rate.alpha_form: For every fixed 0<alpha<3/2, E_N<=6gC_N^2-(sqrt(2 alpha)-o(1))g sigma_N sqrt(log N)
variational_rate.uniform_form: For every c<sqrt(3), E_N<=6gC_N^2-c g sigma_N sqrt(log N) eventually
variational_rate.constant_ceiling: sqrt(3) is the boundary delivered by K1498's present total-variation exponent, not a claimed optimal ground-energy constant
